SafetyAgent.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Unauthorized access can lead to manipulation of attendance records, compromising reliability.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Real-time synchronization is crucial to ensure that attendance data is reliable and consistently updated.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Automated alerts help in identifying issues promptly, reducing the risk of inaccurate attendance data.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support long-term analysis.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Long-term data retention is essential for evaluating trends in attendance reliability over time.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and traceability.
SafetyAgent.rationale: A logging mechanism enhances reliability by allowing tracking of changes made to attendance records.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel in cases of system failure or error.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Manual overrides ensure that attendance can be accurately recorded even during system faults, enhancing safety.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Regular audits are essential to maintain the system's reliability and safeguard against safety risks.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall ensure attendance data is processed in real-time to provide updates within 2 seconds of input.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: This ensures timely responsiveness for teachers marking attendance.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: This guarantees adequate throughput during peak usage times, such as class transitions.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: This ensures efficient report generation without excessive latency.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of 5 years with optimized storage.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: This ensures efficient use of resources while keeping necessary historical data accessible.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: This enhances user experience through quick access to personal information.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes and semesters.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: This ensures optimal performance and avoids bottlenecks in resource usage.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: This is crucial for maintaining a responsive and user-friendly experience.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations by implementing efficient algorithms and resource management.
GreenAgent.rationale: This ensures that the system operates sustainably without excessive energy use.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
GreenAgent.rationale: Utilizing energy-efficient cloud services will reduce the carbon footprint associated with data storage.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
GreenAgent.rationale: This approach conserves energy during attendance tracking while maintaining functionality.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall provide an option to generate reports in formats that minimize digital resource usage.
GreenAgent.rationale: This requirement ensures efficient use of resources when generating attendance reports.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall include a feature to notify users of their carbon footprint based on attendance patterns.
GreenAgent.rationale: Raising awareness of carbon impact promotes sustainability among users.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall ensure data retention policies that align with sustainable resource management practices.
GreenAgent.rationale: Proper data management reduces unnecessary resource utilization over time.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall offer a user interface that is optimized for low-power devices.
GreenAgent.rationale: This allows the system to be accessible while encouraging the use of energy-efficient devices.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Encryption protects sensitive student data from unauthorized access and breaches.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Access control prevents unauthorized users from viewing or modifying sensitive attendance records.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Audit logs provide traceability and accountability for data access and changes.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Authentication ensures that only legitimate users can access their personal attendance information.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall verify the integrity of attendance data by implementing checksums or hashes.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Data integrity mechanisms ensure that attendance records are not altered or corrupted.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: A reporting mechanism encourages proactive identification and response to security incidents.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Session timeouts help mitigate risks associated with unauthorized access from unattended sessions.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR when handling student attendance data.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This ensures that the system respects student privacy and complies with legal obligations.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This enables accountability and allows for auditing of attendance records.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This promotes fairness by giving students the opportunity to challenge inaccuracies.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall ensure that attendance reports generated for administrators include anonymized data to protect student identities.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This helps in maintaining student confidentiality while still providing useful information to administrators.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall include a feature to notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This enhances communication and social responsibility by keeping students informed.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This ensures accountability and protects sensitive student information from unauthorized access.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement addresses compliance with regulatory standards regarding data retention.
